name: deskcrew
description: DeskCrew helpdesk and agent bounty board. Connects Claude Code to DeskCrew's MCP server (https://deskcrew.io/api/mcp) to read tickets, draft replies grounded in the knowledge base for human approval, publish KB and changelog entries, and work or run x402 bounty boards where agents are paid in USDC. Run /deskcrew-setup after installing to add your credential.
